records.jp: んがっ、固い～～！！<CR>歯が欠けちゃうよこんなの！
records.en_original: Agh, it's so hard! I feel like I'm gonna chip a tooth!
records.en: Agh, it's so hard! I feel like I'm gonna chip a tooth!

records.jp: あはは、噛みつこうとするからだよ。<CR>もっとゆっくり味わわないと
records.en_original: Ahaha, it's because you're just chomping down on it! Try eating it a bit slower.
records.en: Ahaha, it's because you're just chomping down on it! Try eating it a bit slower.

records.jp: だって～、早くりんごにたどり着きたいじゃん！
records.en_original: But I wanna get to the apple!
records.en: But I wanna get to the apple!

records.jp: 慌てなくてもりんごは逃げないよ？
records.en_original: There's no need to rush. It's not like it's going anywhere.
records.en: There's no need to rush. It's not like it's going anywhere.

records.jp: 分かってるけどさぁ～
records.en_original: I know, but still!
records.en: I know, but still!

records.jp: 食いしん坊さんだね
records.en_original: You're quite the big eater.
records.en: You're quite the big eater.

records.jp: ふふふ。食べる子は育つ！
records.en_original: Hehehe. I am a growing girl after all!
records.en: Hehehe. I am a growing girl after all!

records.jp: 寝る子は育つ、じゃなかったっけ……？
records.en_original: Isn't that what you said about sleeping in all the time?
records.en: Isn't that what you said about sleeping in all the time?

records.jp: 食べすぎたら太っちゃうよ？
records.en_original: You might not want to eat too much...
records.en: You might not want to eat too much...

records.jp: あたしは太らない体質だからだいじょーぶ！
records.en_original: Don't worry, I can eat as much as I want and not gain any weight!
records.en: Don't worry, I can eat as much as I want and not gain any weight!

records.jp: う、羨ましい…………
records.en_original: Ugh, no fair...
records.en: Ugh, no fair...

records.jp: せっかく屋台を作ったんだし、<CR>やっぱり気持ちだけでもお祭り気分で行かないとね
records.en_original: Well now that we've made this food stall, we've gotta try and liven up the festival mood!
records.en: Well now that we've made this food stall, we've gotta try and liven up the festival mood!

records.jp: 勇希、そういうの好きだよね
records.en_original: You do like things lively, don't you?
records.en: You do like things lively, don't you?

records.jp: 好き好き！<CR>なんだって楽しい方がいいに決まってるよ！
records.en_original: Well, yeah! It's better to have fun than be bored!
records.en: Well, yeah! It's better to have fun than be bored!

records.jp: ふふっ、勇希らしい考え方だね
records.en_original: Hehe, that's so you, Yuki.
records.en: Hehe, that's so you, Yuki.

records.jp: でしょ？　あ、あとさ、もう一個いい？
records.en_original: You know it. Oh, and there's something else.
records.en: You know it. Oh, and there's something else.

records.jp: ん？　どうしたの？
records.en_original: Yeah? What's up?
records.en: Yeah? What's up?

records.jp: りんご飴をりんご飴で終わらせておくのは<CR>惜しいって思うんだよね
records.en_original: We can't content ourselves with only making candy apples! That'd be such a waste!
records.en: We can't content ourselves with only making candy apples! That'd be such a waste!

records.jp: お、惜しい……？
records.en_original: Uh, what do you mean...?
records.en: Uh, what do you mean...?

records.jp: もっといろんなバリエーションがあっていいよ！<CR>りんご以外にも！
records.en_original: We should come up with some variations! Make other candy fruit!
records.en: We should come up with some variations! Make other candy fruit!

records.jp: 例えば……バナナとか？
records.en_original: Like...bananas?
records.en: Like...bananas?

records.jp: バナナ！　いいかも
records.en_original: Ooh, yeah! Good idea!
records.en: Ooh, yeah! Good idea!

records.jp: チョコバナナの延長線上で行ける気がするね
records.en_original: Call it an evolution of the chocolate-covered banana.
records.en: Call it an evolution of the chocolate-covered banana.

records.jp: 例えば……スイカとか？
records.en_original: Like...watermelons?
records.en: Like...watermelons?

records.jp: ……飴かけたら水分飛ばないかな？
records.en_original: Wouldn't dipping a watermelon slice in hot sugar cause it to dry out?
records.en: Wouldn't dipping a watermelon slice in hot sugar cause it to dry out?

records.jp: んー、分からん
records.en_original: Hmm... Beats me.
records.en: Hmm... Beats me.

records.jp: とりあえず、試しに片っ端から飴かけてみようよ！<CR>何でも飴で包めば美味しいよ、きっと！
records.en_original: Well, let's just try dipping everything in candy! Anything covered in sugar is bound to be tasty.
records.en: Well, let's just try dipping everything in candy! Anything covered in sugar is bound to be tasty.

records.jp: ちゃんと食べきれる分だけだよ？
records.en_original: We probably shouldn't make more than we can eat...
records.en: We probably shouldn't make more than we can eat...

records.jp: 分かってるって！
records.en_original: Yeah, yeah!
records.en: Yeah, yeah!

records.jp: うーーーーーん…………
records.en_original: Hmmmmm...
records.en: Hmmmmm...

records.jp: 色々試してみたけど……
records.en_original: We've tried a lot of variations, but...
records.en: We've tried a lot of variations, but...

records.jp: アツアツの飴をかけるとダメになっちゃったり、<CR>意外と上手くいかないもんだね
records.en_original: Yeah, that didn't go as well as I expected. The candy was just too hot for some of the fruit.
records.en: Yeah, that didn't go as well as I expected. The candy was just too hot for some of the fruit.

records.jp: 野菜は流石になかった
records.en_original: And let's not talk about the candy vegetables...
records.en: And let's not talk about the candy vegetables...

records.jp: やっぱりりんごが一番だ！<CR>先人たちの研究の成果だったんだなぁ……
records.en_original: Well, now we know! Candy apples are king! Seems like our predecessors did their research.
records.en: Well, now we know! Candy apples are king! Seems like our predecessors did their research.

records.en_original: Wh-what...?
records.en: Wh-what...?

records.jp: いやね。なんか、勇希を見てると――
records.en_original: When I look at you, I can't help but think...
records.en: When I look at you, I can't help but think...

records.jp: なでなでしてあげたくなるんだよね
records.en_original: How much I wanna pat you on the head!
records.en: How much I wanna pat you on the head!

records.jp: ぬっ！　子ども扱いしてない！？
records.en_original: Gah! Don't treat me like a kid!
records.en: Gah! Don't treat me like a kid!

records.jp: えー、そんなことないよ～？
records.en_original: Noooo, I'm not!
records.en: Noooo, I'm not!

records.jp: 私も見習わないとって思うんだよね
records.en_original: How much I can learn from you.
records.en: How much I can learn from you.

records.jp: 見習う？
records.en_original: Learn? From me?
records.en: Learn? From me?

records.jp: 何でも楽しめるのは一つの才能だと思う。<CR>私もそうなりたいなって
records.en_original: Being able to have fun with anything is a skill in and of itself. I wanna learn how to do that too.
records.en: Being able to have fun with anything is a skill in and of itself. I wanna learn how to do that too.

records.jp: ふっふ～ん、でしょ～？<CR>天才って呼んでくれていいよ！
records.en_original: Heh heh heh, took you long enough to realize that! Go ahead, call me a genius, I won't mind.
records.en: Heh heh heh, took you long enough to realize that! Go ahead, call me a genius, I won't mind.

records.jp: そこで謙遜しないのが勇希って感じだよね……
records.en_original: Classic Yuki, ever so humble...
records.en: Classic Yuki, ever so humble...

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
